catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbate-giusep: This 1913 Catholic Encyclopedia article on Abbate Giuseppe Baini — the Italian priest and musicologist, biographer of Palestrina — sketches his life and works. Joseph Otten honors a pioneer of musical scholarship. A useful reference on a learned churchman. Palestrina's fame owes much to this devoted biographer's labors.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-our-: This entry treats Gethsemani, the Trappist abbey in Kentucky's hills. French monks brought silence to America. Edmond Obrecht recounts its growth. The strict life, transplanted west. Thomas Merton would later make its name known worldwide. Its cheese and fruitcake support the monks.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-trin: This entry treats La Cava, the cliff abbey by Salerno. Its charters fill volumes of history. Umberto Benigni praises its archive. A thousand years of parchment and prayer. Lombard princes endowed it with lands and gold. Its abbots were barons of the realm.
